description: Election Commission - Declare that K. R. G. C. Bandara as a member of the Dimbulagala P/S
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Dimbulagala Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new member by a political party, which falls under election-related matters.
